summary: Thai cooking school in Bangkok and Phuket offering hands-on classes and multi-month cooking programs that include a DTV enrolment letter.

facts.label: DTV enrolment letter
facts.value: Programs include an enrolment letter for a 5-year multiple-entry DTV
facts.quote: Enrollment letter for a 5-year multiple-entry Destination Thailand Visa (DTV)

facts.label: Class format
facts.value: 8 group classes of 2.5 hours each in the 9-month program

facts.label: Market tour
facts.value: Four group classes include a local market tour with tuk-tuk ride
facts.quote: 4 group classes with local market tour (3.5 hrs each, includes tuk-tuk ride)

facts.label: Locations
facts.value: Bangkok (Sukhumvit and Sathon) and Phuket (Kata Karon)
facts.quote: Bangkok (Sukhumvit & Sathon, nearby BTS skytrain and MRT subway) and Phuket (Kata Karon)
